DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ごきげんよう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はシャーレ当番の日ですので

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 失礼のないよう、まずはこうしてご挨拶のメッセージをいたしました

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: そんなにかしこまらなくていいのに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ご負担でしたでしょうか……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: いや、そこまでじゃないけど、もっと気軽に話して欲しいかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 承知いたしました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは今日一日、どうぞよろしくお願いいたしますわね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生のご予定を伺っても良いでしょうか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もうすぐアイスホッケーカップの準決勝があるのです！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よろしければその日にご一緒できればと思うのですが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 申し訳ございません

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生のご都合も伺わずに勝手に……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気にしないで！タカネが嬉しそうで安心したよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうでしたか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よかったですわ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 日程をもらったら調整するね。あとで送ってほしいな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい、ありがとうございます！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本日、ですわ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お忘れではありませんわよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私もすごく楽しみにしていたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: はい！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは、出版部の部室でお待ちしておりますわね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先日はアイスホッケーを一緒に鑑賞してくださり、ありがとうございました

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ですが

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あの日いろいろとあったことについては

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私……本当に申し訳なく思っております……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気にしなくていいよ。私も楽しかったし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ、そうですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで、なのですが！お詫びも兼ねて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は私からお昼をご馳走したいと思いまして

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: タカネの手料理！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょうど今日は「もやし祭」の日でもありますし

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もやし……まつり？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ごきげんよう、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: なんだかご機嫌だね、タカネ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ！とても良いことがありまして……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、ご存じですか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今夜、オーロラが見られるらしいのです！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なので、風景写真を撮りに行こうかと

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その……もしよろしければ……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ご一緒に、いかがでしょう？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: オーロラの風景写真？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ええ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もちろん、お忙しいのは重々承知ですので……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ご無理はなさらず……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 断っていただいても構いませんわ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: タカネのお願いだもん、行かないとね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 合法的に残業抜け出せるし、行こうかな！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんな風に仰っていただけるなんて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 少し……恥ずかしいですけれど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 本当に、感謝いたしますわ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その気持ち、少しわかりますわ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 締切前になると散歩にでかけたくなりますものね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それでは、お待ちしておりますわ

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 샬레의 당번 일을 맞아, 실례가 되지 않도록.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 먼저 이렇게, 문안 톡을 보내고자 합니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그렇게 너무 예의를 차릴 필요는 없어……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그 정도는 아닌데, 나는 타카네와 편하게 지내고 싶어서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러면 오늘 하루 당번, 잘 부탁드리겠습니다.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 사실 곧 아이스하키 준결승전이 열릴 예정이어서요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가능하시다면 그때 약속을 잡는 게 어떨까 하는데요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러면 일단 출판부로 와 주시면 될 것 같아요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 마침 곧 콩나물 축제를 하는 날이어서요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 밤, 오로라를 볼 수 있대요!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 풍경 사진을 찍으러 갈까 하는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그 마음 저도 알 것 같아요.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 마감일 전에는 뭐든 탈출 거리를 찾게 마련이죠.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Greetings, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: For my upcoming Student Rep duty at Schale, I thought it proper

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: for me to announce my presence beforehand.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You don't have to be too formal...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Does that bother you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: No, but we can be more casual, Takane.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Very well.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Regardless, I look forward to working with you today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: When would be a good time for you, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: To be frank, the ice hockey semi-finals are about to start

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: so we could meet around that time and watch the program together?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That was presumptuous of me, wasn't it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm glad you feel more comfortable!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is that so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm relieved...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Please send me your proposed time and I will try my best to accommodate.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That means...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Excellent! Thank you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Today is the day!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You remember what we're doing, don't you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Of course. I made a promise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Indubitably!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then, please come to the Publishing Department!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I appreciate you watching hockey with me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: About...that...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sorry...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's fine. I had fun too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: REGARDLESS!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: To return your graciousness and issue a proper apology...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was thinking I could make you lunch?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Takane's cooking?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: A bean sprout festival is about to start...if you're interested.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: A festival...just for bean sprouts?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Hello, Sensei!!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You seem excited, Takane.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: With good reason!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you know why?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The aurora should show tonight! The sky is clear!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought I could practice my photography.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you are free and interested

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: would you like to join me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Taking photos of the aurora...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: As I said.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Of course, if you're feeling overly stressed

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: or

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: if it's too much trouble, that's fine. No pressure...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: If Takane says go, then I go!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: And that means I can leave work early!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Uh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm happy to hear that

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: even if it's a bit embarrassing.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I know what you mean, though.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Taking any excuse to escape a deadline...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then, I'll be waiting for you.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สบายดีรึเปล่าคะ คุณครู?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถึงคราวที่ฉันจะไปเข้าเวรที่ชาเล่ต์
แล้ว หวังว่าจะไม่เป็นการรบกวนนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันเลยส่งข้อความมาแจ้งล่วงหน้า
แบบนี้ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ต้องสุภาพขนาดนั้นก็ได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูรู้สึกอึดอัดเหรอคะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ก็ไม่ขนาดนั้นหรอก แต่ว่าครู
อยากคุยสบายๆ กับทาคาเนะน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจแล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้างั้นการเข้าเวรของฉันวันนี้
ต้องขอฝากตัวด้วยนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู พอจะสะดวกตอนไหนบ้างคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอดีจะมีการแข่งไอซ์ฮอกกี้รอบ
รองชนะเลิศเร็วๆ นี้น่ะค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูสะดวก ฉันก็อยากนัดไว้
ล่วงหน้าค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอโทษนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันถามแบบไม่มีมารยาทเกินไป
ใช่มั้ยคะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูดีใจมากกว่าที่ทาคาเนะมาชวนนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โล่งอกไปทีค่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าบอกวันที่ไว้ ครูจะทำตัวให้ว่างนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็หมายความว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ! ขอบคุณค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เรานัดกันวันนี้ค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: จำได้อยู่ใช่มั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
สัญญากับทาคาเนะไว้ทั้งที
ครูจำได้อยู่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้างั้นรบกวนมาที่ชมรมสื่อสิ่งพิมพ์
ก่อนนะคะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่มาดูไอซ์ฮอกกี้ด้วยกันนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นเมื่อตอนนั้น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันต้อง... ขอโทษด้วยนะคะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่เป็นไรหรอก ครูว่าสนุกดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้น!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพื่อเป็นการขอโทษและตอบแทน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันอยากเตรียมมื้อกลางวันให้คุณครู
น่ะค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อาหารจากทาคาเนะเหรอ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ใกล้จะถึงเทศกาลถั่วงอกพอดีน่ะค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เทศกาล... ถั่วงอกเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สวัสดีค่ะ คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ดูร่าเริงมาเลยนะ ทาคาเนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูรู้หรือเปล่าคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คืนนี้จะมีแสงเหนือให้เห็นค่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันว่าจะไปถ่ายรูปแสงเหนือสักหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าคุณครูสะดวกละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไปด้วยกัน... มั้ยคะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไปถ่ายรูปแสงเหนือเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ใช่ค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ถ้าคุณครูไม่สะดวก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าไม่อยากไปละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทาคาเนะมาขอทั้งที ครูต้องไปสิ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ได้โดดงานแบบมีเหตุผลทั้งที
ต้องไปอยู่แล้ว!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่คิดอย่างนั้นค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ก็... น่าเขินนิดหน่อยนะคะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ๊ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันก็เข้าใจความรู้สึกนั้นค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ายังไม่ถึงวันส่งงาน เราจะหาทาง
โดดงานอยู่แล้วค่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้างั้นฉันจะรอนะคะ

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 由於今天輪到我擔任值日生

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了避免失禮，在此先向您致上問候的訊息

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 倒也沒有，只是我希望能跟貴音相處得自在一點

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼今天的值日生工作，還請您多多指教

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，請問您什麼時候方便呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實不久後就是冰上曲棍球的準決賽了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果可以的話，感覺約那個時間還挺不錯的！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我很高興貴音願意放輕鬆跟我說話哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我會盡量配合，把日期告訴我吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 當然，畢竟是和貴音的約定嘛

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，請您先到出版部來就可以了！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之前能和我一起看冰上曲棍球，真的非常感謝

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒關係。反正我也挺開心的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 作為回禮和對您的歉意

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想招待您吃一頓午餐！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 是貴音親手做的料理嗎！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 正好也快到豆芽祭的日子了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今晚好像能看到極光哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，我正在考慮要不要去拍風景照

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 既然是貴音的邀請，肯定要去！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 而且能合法躲過加班，當然得去囉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不過……也讓人有點害羞呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我也能夠理解那種心情

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 在截稿日前，總是會想找出所有能逃離現場的藉口呢
